scope: Live follow-up sweep of public repositories and publisher records for an independent synchronized HRS station-to-vehicle holdout

search_sources.query: hydrogen refueling station raw data pressure temperature mass flow dataset csv
hydrogen fueling station experimental data supplementary csv pressure temperature flow
site:zenodo.org hydrogen refueling station fueling data pressure temperature
site:github.com hydrogen refueling station measured data csv

eligibility_rule.required_rights: explicit reuse permission or public terms covering derived metrics and journal publication

candidates.title: National Fuel Cell Technology Evaluation Center (NFCTEC)
candidates.observed_scope: NLR describes operational, maintenance and safety data processed on an off-network system; raw partner data are secured and individualized results are shared with partners, while public outputs are aggregated composite data products.
candidates.claim_boundary: Public CDPs may support operating-range context only; no synchronized raw station-to-vehicle trace was obtained.

candidates.title: H2FillS Hydrogen Filling Simulation
candidates.observed_scope: The official page describes a station-to-FCEV thermodynamic simulator validated with empirical fueling datasets and requiring registration for download; no independent raw measurement archive was publicly retrieved.
candidates.claim_boundary: Useful protocol/model comparison reference; simulator or bundled empirical profiles cannot be counted as an untouched measured holdout.

candidates.title: Temperature Rise on Liner Surfaces of Fuel Cell Electric Vehicle Tanks during Fueling Process
candidates.observed_scope: The paper reports NREL HITRF and Powertech fueling experiments with pressure/temperature boundary observations, but its data-availability statement says research data are not shared. It lacks a public synchronized station controller/dispenser/vehicle archive.
candidates.claim_boundary: May support tank-boundary face validity and a data-request lead only; not full-loop validation.

candidates.title: Hydrogen station in situ back-to-back fueling data for design and modeling
candidates.observed_scope: The article describes one year of Cal State LA station data and back-to-back fueling behavior, including pressure, thermodynamics and vehicle SOC, but the public record exposes no machine-readable synchronized event-level logger or reuse terms for derived metrics.
candidates.request_route: Cal State LA HRFF data custodian route retained in the acquisition queue.
candidates.claim_boundary: Real-station provenance and request lead only.

candidates.title: Measurement uncertainty tool for HRS dispensers
candidates.observed_scope: The public Zenodo record contains a PDF describing a dispenser measurement-uncertainty tool; no synchronized station-to-vehicle measurement rows are included.

candidates.title: Thermodynamic modeling and simulation of subcooled liquid hydrogen refueling for transport applications
candidates.observed_scope: The public record contains an article describing a liquid-hydrogen refueling model and simulation scenarios; it does not expose measured station-to-vehicle logger rows.

candidates.title: DOE/NLR December 2022 H2IQ Hour high-throughput hydrogen fueling slides
candidates.observed_scope: Official slides report 2022 HDVS fast-flow demonstrations and show time-series pressure, temperature and mass-flow charts. The public artifact exposes chart graphics and summary values (including 61.5 kg and 82.3 kg demonstrations) but no machine-readable synchronized logger rows, calibration file or full controller-state export.
candidates.claim_boundary: Useful independent operating-range and face-validity context. Chart digitization would be a derived benchmark with reading uncertainty, not a clean raw holdout; it cannot close the frozen full-loop gate without custodian confirmation and raw channel release.

candidates.title: DOE/NLR March 2024 H2IQ Hour HD fueling protocol experimental results
candidates.observed_scope: Official slides/text report an SAE J2601-5 HD protocol test with station/hose/vehicle pressures, valve position, mass flow and temperature plots and summary values (73 kg, 423.5 s, 172.3 g/s average, 483.33 g/s peak). Public access is presentation graphics and prose, not an event-level raw trace with channel dictionary and calibration metadata.
candidates.claim_boundary: Strong independent protocol and operating-range context. It is not promoted to full-loop validation; a raw NLR release or approved de-identified export is still required.

candidates.title: DOE 2024 Annual Merit Review heavy-duty fueling protocol slide
candidates.observed_scope: The official review slide states a 70.5 kg seven-minute HDVS fill and shows pressure/flow protocol charts, but does not provide synchronized raw event rows or reuse metadata for a numerical holdout.
candidates.claim_boundary: Independent public performance context only; do not count it as a separate raw validation case.

next_action: Prioritize approved data requests to NLR NFCTEC/HITRF and Cal State LA HRFF; the DOE/NLR slide records are now retained as independent chart-only leads. Require a de-identified synchronized export, channel dictionary, calibration metadata, protocol/controller states and written publication rights before outcome access.
claim_boundary: This sweep records discovery and exclusion decisions. It adds no numerical validation, does not alter frozen holdout results and does not permit IJHE or full-objective completion.
